0.title: Million Dollar Question
0.description: Ask: "What would you do if you won a million right now?"
hints: "What's at the top of your list?"

1.title: Say hello
1.description: Say hello to a stranger as you pass by.

3.title: Style compliment
3.description: Ask a woman where she got her dress or shoes.
hints: "Your shoes are amazing, where did you get them?"
"May I ask where you bought that?"

4.title: Sympathy compliment
4.description: Tell a woman that she has a pleasant charisma.
hints: "It's easy to tell that you spread good cheer."

5.title: Small talk for directions
5.description: Ask a woman for directions and then have 2-3 sentences of small talk.
hints: "Excuse me, can you help me for a moment?"

6.title: Traffic light compliment
6.description: Tell a woman at the traffic light that she is beaming and wish her a nice day.
hints: "Keep it up, you make the street more beautiful."

7.title: Smile at server
7.description: Compliment the server on her smile.
hints: "Thank you, you really have a beautiful smile."

8.title: Love at first sight
8.description: Ask a woman if she believes in love at first sight.
hints: "Do you believe in love at first sight?"

9.title: Lost Bet Ice Cream
9.description: Say you lost a bet and have to ask her about her favorite ice cream flavor.
hints: "I lost a bet... what's your favorite flavor?"
"Help me please, otherwise I'll have to do more nonsense."
"So, which ice cream is your favorite?"

11.title: Headphone Music
11.description: Ask a woman what she's listening to on her headphones.
hints: "May I ask what you're listening to?"

12.title: Selfie with a reason
12.description: Take a selfie with someone and say it's for your challenge.
hints: "For my challenge: a selfie with the most beautiful smile in town."
"Would you like to join me for a minute?"
"I only need one photo, then I'll leave you alone."

13.title: Look familiar
13.description: Walk up to a person and say that they look familiar to you.

16.title: Perfume compliment
16.description: Tell a woman that her perfume smells good. You could be in a cafe near her.

17.title: Coffee or cocktail
17.description: Ask: "Are you more of a coffee or a cocktail person?"

18.title: Direct Compliment
18.description: Say: "I have to say, you look incredibly good." and then just move on.

20.title: If we meet again
20.description: Say: "If I see you again, I owe you an ice cream."
hints: "Deal? If I see you again, ice cream on me."

21.title: Number when leaving
21.description: As you walk away, say: "If I'm brave enough to talk to you, you're brave enough to give me your number."
hints: "I am, so now it's your turn."
"Otherwise we'll never see each other again."

22.title: Wingman Mission
22.description: Go up to a group of girls with a friend and introduce yourselves charmingly.
hints: "Hi, we wanted to get to know you."
"You look nice, thought we'd say hi."
"We're on a courage mission right now."

25.title: Dance Challenge
25.description: Challenge a group of women to a short TikTok dance.

26.title: Group Instagram
26.description: Go up to several girls and ask if you can take a group photo for Insta.
hints: "Can we take a group photo for Insta?"

27.title: Wedding invitation
27.description: Say to a group for fun: "We're getting married soon, pick your seats now!"

28.title: Beauty Jury
28.description: Pretend you are judges and award points for outfits.

29.title: Who is single?
29.description: Ask directly: "Quick statistics round, which of you is single?"

30.title: Mobile Phone Roulette
30.description: Let the girls take one of your phones and stalk you on Insta.
hints: "Believe me, you want to see this."

31.title: Have your friend judge
31.description: Introduce a friend: "On a scale of 1-10, how cute is he?"
hints: "Don't worry, he'll only cry for a moment."

32.title: Dance-Off
32.description: Challenge a group to a dance-off – whoever loses pays ice cream.

33.title: Pick-Up Quiz
33.description: Say: "We're practicing pick-up lines, rate them from 1-10."

34.title: Selfie Battle
34.description: Have a selfie competition: Whoever takes the funniest picture with the group.

35.title: Blind Date Call
35.description: Ask a group: "Do you know anyone you can introduce us to?"

36.title: Shared Story
36.description: Make a Boomerang or short Insta video with a group.

37.title: Fake Bachelor
37.description: Pretend you're at the Bachelor casting: "Who gets the rose?"

38.title: Worst Pick-Up Line
38.description: Say: "We're collecting the worst pick-up lines. Do you have any?"

39.title: Spontaneous Karaoke
39.description: Start singing and invite the group to join in.

40.title: Brave Excuse
40.description: Go to a group: "We lost a courage challenge, we were allowed to choose you."
hints: "So now you have to go through with it."

42.title: Flirt Scale
42.description: Ask: "On a scale of 1 to 10 – how well can you flirt?"
hints: "I'd be interested to see your score."

44.title: WhatsApp now
44.description: Say: "You have a really cool way of being. It would be a shame if this were the last conversation... do you have WhatsApp?"

45.title: Send something later
45.description: Say: "Can I send you something funny later? Give me your number."
hints: "Give me your number, send you something funny later."
"It will be worth it, I promise."

46.title: We should see each other again
46.description: Say: "I bet you're someone we should see more often. What do you think?"

47.title: Guess your Insta handle
47.description: Play a guessing game: "I'm going to guess your Insta handle. If I'm wrong, you owe me a coffee."

48.title: Music video
48.description: Say as you walk by: "Holy shit, you look like you came straight out of a music video."
hints: "You look like you're in a music video."

49.title: Spontaneous Date
49.description: Ask: "What are you doing right now? Let's spontaneously get a coffee somewhere."

52.title: Give me a compliment
52.description: Say: "Give me a compliment. I just deserved one."
hints: "I just took a risk, reward me."
"I'm curious to see what you come up with."

54.title: Right after number
54.description: Say: "I find you super interesting. Give me your number, we should do this again."
hints: "It would be a shame if we didn't continue this."

56.title: Type in phone number
56.description: Type your number into her phone in the middle of a conversation: "Trust me, this is the best thing that's happened to you today."
hints: "Give me your phone for a minute."

57.title: Date Provocation
57.description: Say: "We should go on a date – you seem like you'll miss me otherwise."

58.title: Address a group
58.description: Go to a women's group and introduce yourself to everyone at once.

60.title: Dare game for two
60.description: Say to someone: "We both have to compliment a stranger. Whoever laughs first loses."

61.title: Awkward Story Duel
61.description: Say: "Let's dare: we both tell an embarrassing story. Whoever is more embarrassing wins."

62.title: Handshake Poker
62.description: Play rock-paper-scissors with a group of women. The loser has to reveal a secret.
hints: "Only fair, whoever loses has to deliver."

63.title: Give a nickname
63.description: Give everyone in the group a spontaneous, funny nickname.
hints: "I've thought of something dangerous for you."

64.title: Find the greatest flirt queen
64.description: Ask: "Who of you is the greatest flirt queen?"

65.title: Fake Wedding Photo
65.description: Take a posed "bride and groom" photo with a woman, the group as the audience.
hints: "We need you as our wedding party."

66.title: In love? Test
66.description: Asks: "What would a guy have to do to make you fall in love instantly?"

67.title: Spontaneous speed dating
67.description: Everyone in your group speaks briefly to everyone in their group.

68.title: Who pays first?
68.description: Suggest a coin toss: If you win, they owe you an ice cream – otherwise the other way around.

69.title: Fashion show on the street
69.description: Challenge the group: "Who has the best runway walk?"

70.title: Spontaneous friend request
70.description: Says: "You look so cool, we have to be official friends now."

71.title: Would You Rather
71.description: Start a "Would You Rather?" game with the group.
hints: "We'll start: Who would you most likely marry someone on vacation?"

72.title: Instagram Swap
72.description: Give each other your phones and follow each other directly on Insta.

73.title: Introduce Syntra
73.description: Go to someone and introduce Syntra. Ask what they think of the concept.
hints: "Do you know social apps like Syntra?"
"What do you think of a courage challenge app like this?"

74.title: Ask about your calling
74.description: Ask: "You look interesting, what do you do for a living?" and then ask two questions about it.
hints: "What do you like most about it?"

75.title: Hello to strangers
75.description: Say hello to 5 strangers as they pass by. Smile and maintain eye contact.

76.title: AI Small Talk
76.description: Start small talk or flirting and say "wait a minute" 3 sentences later, then pretend to ask AI.

77.title: Earring Compliment
77.description: Find someone with earrings and say that they caught your eye.

78.title: Flower Gift
78.description: Buy or pick a flower and give it to someone without wanting anything in return.

79.title: Style compliments
79.description: Compliment a woman's and a man's style.

80.title: Girl with mother
80.description: Talk to a girl who is out with her mother.

81.title: Talk to mother
81.description: Talk to the mother of a girl.

82.title: Restaurant compliment
82.description: Go to a table outside and say: "You are the best-looking table here. Enjoy your meal!"
hints: "I just had to get that off my chest."

83.title: Syntra Feedback
83.description: Go to a group of friends: "You look like you go out a lot. Can I ask you something?" Introduce Syntra and get feedback.
hints: "Do you think the idea is cool?"

84.title: Water for cashier
84.description: Buy something for yourself + an extra water and give it to the person at the checkout.

91.title: Group Courage
91.description: Approach a group of women and introduce yourself to everyone at once: "Hi, I'm [Name], you look so nice, I had to meet you."

122.title: Say great smile
122.description: Say to a woman as you walk past: "Sorry, but I just have to tell you: you have a really great smile."
hints: "Sorry, I just had to say that."

123.title: Admire a beard
123.description: Stop a guy with a beard and ask: "Would you tell me how long it took you to grow that beard? I'm jealous."

124.title: Praise phone outfit
124.description: Talk to a woman who is on the phone after she's finished: "Sorry, I had to wait... I think your outfit is great."
hints: "Sorry, I had to wait until you were finished."

125.title: Approach a laughing group
125.description: Go to a group that is laughing and ask: "Hey, I want to laugh too, what was so funny?"
hints: "Do you want to tell me the secret?"
"I need something to laugh about too."

126.title: Ask someone who listens to music
126.description: Say to someone with headphones: "Just a quick break: what are you listening to? Maybe I'll discover a new hit."
hints: "I'm looking for new music, do you have any tips?"

127.title: Praise a bag
127.description: Say to someone with a colorful bag: "May I compliment you on your bag? It's really cool."

128.title: Praise red hair
128.description: Say to a woman with red hair: "Okay, your hair is amazing, I had to get that off my chest."

129.title: Ask a skateboard trick
129.description: Ask a guy with a skateboard: "Can you do a trick? I'll give you a standing ovation."

130.title: Dress Compliment
130.description: Say to a woman in a dress: "It's only a short one, but that dress suits you incredibly well."

131.title: Ask a dog to pet
131.description: Go up to someone with a dog and ask: "He's really cute, can I pet him for a moment?"

132.title: Couple newly in love
132.description: Speak to a couple: "Sorry, I just had to say you look like you're newly in love."

133.title: Sunglasses compliment
133.description: Say to someone wearing sunglasses: "You look so mysterious in those glasses. On purpose?"

134.title: Coffee-to-go question
134.description: Go to a woman with a coffee-to-go cup: "Is this the best coffee in town, or just decoration?"
hints: "Does the coffee here really taste that good?"
"I'm always looking for the best coffee."

135.title: Tattoo Story
135.description: Talk to someone with a tattoo on their arm: "That looks awesome, does it have a story?"

136.title: Elegance despite haste
136.description: Say to a woman who is hurrying: "Don't worry, you are still elegance personified."

137.title: Football Shirt Question
137.description: Ask a guy wearing a football shirt: "Do you play the game yourself or are you just a passionate couch potato?"
hints: "Are you a player or a fan?"

138.title: Ask to Adopt
138.description: Say to a group: "Could you adopt me for a moment? You look like you're having fun."
hints: "I want to be part of this group too."

139.title: Praise a funny shirt
139.description: Say to someone wearing a funny shirt: "Awesome shirt! Where can you get one of those?"

140.title: Praise large earrings
140.description: Stop a woman with particularly large earrings and say: "Can I say that your earrings are a real statement?"

141.title: Best thing this week
141.description: Ask a stranger: "Spontaneously... what is the best thing that happened to you this week?"

142.title: Praise dream hair
142.description: Say to a woman with long hair: "Sorry, but your hair is a dream."

143.title: Read a jute bag
143.description: Go up to someone with a jute bag and say: "I have to read what it says - can I?"

144.title: Praise a full beard
144.description: Stop a guy with a full beard: "Bro, Viking vibes. I was just going to say that."

145.title: Praise neon colors
145.description: Say to a woman wearing neon colors: "Okay, wow, you're really adding color here."

148.title: Praise laughter
148.description: Say to a woman who is laughing: "Your laughter is contagious, please keep going."

149.title: Secret Group
149.description: Stop a group: "You look like you have a secret. What's your plan today?"

150.title: Piercing brave
150.description: Say to someone with a piercing: "Brave! I've always wanted to, but I'm a coward."

151.title: Spontaneous wisdom
151.description: Ask a stranger: "Can I buy a piece of spontaneous wisdom from you?"

152.title: Take a photo of pink hair
152.description: Find someone with pink hair and ask if you can take a photo of their hair.
hints: "Can I take a photo of your hair?"
"I've never seen a color like that before."
"Mega cool, can I take a picture?"

153.title: Compliment eye-catching jewelry
153.description: Find a woman with eye-catching jewelry (e.g. large earrings) and compliment her.

155.title: Full Beard Viking
155.description: Find a man with a full beard and tell him he looks like a Viking.

156.title: Ask about a band shirt
156.description: Spot someone wearing a band shirt (AC/DC, Nirvana, etc.) and ask if they've seen the band live.
hints: "Have you ever been to a concert by the band?"

157.title: Sneaker Origin
157.description: Find a person with colored sneakers and ask where they got them.
hints: "I'm looking for some like that too."

159.title: Ask about tattoo meaning
159.description: Find someone with a tattoo on their arm and ask what it means.

160.title: Lipstick Compliment
160.description: Spot a woman wearing bright red lipstick and tell her the color looks amazing.

161.title: Ask the dog and pet it
161.description: Find someone with a dog, ask what its name is and if you can pet the dog.

162.title: Group dressed in black
162.description: Find a group that is all dressed in black and ask if they are a band.
hints: "I'm curious to hear what you play."

163.title: Care tips for long hair
163.description: Find a woman with very long hair and ask if she has any tips on how to care for it.
hints: "How do you care for your hair?"
"So long, it must be a lot of work."

164.title: Take a photo of a skateboard
164.description: Find someone with a skateboard or longboard and take a photo of the board.
hints: "Can I take a photo of your board?"
"Looks cool, what kind of tricks do you do?"

165.title: Read out funny shirt
165.description: Find a person with a funny T-shirt, read the saying out loud and laugh together.
hints: "What does it say? Haha, that's good!"
"I've never seen a shirt like that before."

166.title: Nose Piercing Pain Question
166.description: Find someone with a nose piercing and ask if it hurt.

167.title: Selfie with Sunglasses Group
167.description: Find a group where at least one person is wearing sunglasses and take a selfie with them.

168.title: Flip-Flops Summer Saying
168.description: Find someone wearing flip-flops and say: "You're really living summer!"

169.title: Headphones Music Question
169.description: Find a person with headphones and ask what they are listening to.
hints: "What's playing on your phone right now?"

170.title: Couple Holding Hands
170.description: Find a couple holding hands and wish them a nice day.
hints: "You look cute, have a nice day!"

171.title: Compliment painted fingernails
171.description: Find someone with strikingly painted fingernails and pay them a compliment.

172.title: Waiting on the Phone
172.description: Find someone who is on the phone, wait until they finish, and say: "You looked like it was an important call!"
hints: "Thanks for waiting, I needed to talk to you."

173.title: Ask a laughing group
173.description: Find a group that is laughing, go to them and ask what was so funny.

175.title: Read out the saying on a jute bag
175.description: Find a person with a jute bag and read out loud what it says.

176.title: Praise barefoot on a meadow
176.description: Find someone who is walking barefoot on a meadow and say: "Being barefoot is the best feeling, isn't it?"

177.title: Summer Flower Compliment
177.description: Find a woman with a floral pattern on her dress or scarf and say: "You really bring summer vibes with you."

178.title: Football Shirt Player Question
178.description: Find someone with a football shirt and ask if they play.

179.title: Listen to a music group
179.description: Find a group where someone plays guitar or makes music and listen for a bit.
hints: "Cool music, do you play it often?"

180.title: Selfie with unusual hair color
180.description: Find someone with unusual hair color (blue, green, etc.) and take a selfie with them.
hints: "Can I take a photo with you?"

181.title: Ask about favorite ice cream flavor
181.description: Find someone who eats ice cream and ask what their favorite flavor is.
hints: "Which ice cream flavor do you like best?"
